title: Heavy Diesel Mechanic (Tarnhaven depot)
description: Employer ref HDT-0412. Join our Tarnhaven workshop team of eight servicing linehaul units and trailers: scheduled servicing, breakdowns, brakes and suspension, diagnostics. Hours Mon-Fri 7:00am-3:30pm, occasional Saturday overtime by agreement. Requirements: heavy automotive trade certificate (Level 4) or equivalent; current Class 2 licence (required for yard moves and road tests); air brake experience. Nice to have: laptop diagnostics, trailer and drawbar work.

title: Mobile Service Technician
description: Day shift, Mon-Fri. You'll drive our service truck to customer sites across the region and carry out roadside and on-site repairs. The service truck is a 26-tonne rigid that requires a Class 4 licence. Requirements: current Class 4 licence held at start date (required, no exceptions); heavy diesel trade certificate; air brake experience essential. Nice to have: hydraulics.

title: Workshop Supervisor - Heavy Plant
description: On-site supervisor for our Kestrel Flats heavy plant workshop, Mon-Fri days with an on-call roster. You must live within 30 minutes of the Kestrel Flats site for call-outs. No relocation assistance is offered. Requirements: 8+ years heavy diesel or heavy plant experience; 2+ years supervising a workshop team; trade certificate.

title: Hydraulics Technician
description: Mon-Fri 7:30am-4:00pm at our Tarnhaven yard. Diagnose and repair hydraulic systems on our excavators, loaders and truck-mounted cranes. Requirements: trade certificate in heavy automotive or diesel plant; hydraulic fault-finding experience. Preferred: excavator experience (we'll train the right person). Desirable: forklift certificate. Class 2 licence an advantage.

title: Brake & Suspension Technician
description: Four-day week, Mon-Thu 7:00am-5:00pm. Brake, axle and suspension work on trucks and trailers in a busy independent workshop. Requirements: heavy automotive trade certificate; air brake experience. Desirable: Certificate of Fitness (CoF) inspection experience; we'll support you to get certified.
